title: Susquehanna Outfitters
specs: Navigate exciting rapids through Dauphin Narrows and see local wildlife
See largest nesting island for wading birds in Pennsylvania
Birding floats pass Wade Island with great egrets, night herons, cormorants
Paddle experience levels defined: Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced
Proper water levels required for trips; trips not run if Susquehanna River above 5 feet
Group cancellation policy for 8 or more people: 0-3 days no refund, 3-7 days 50% refund via gift card, over 7 days full refund via gift card
blurb: Guests can rent kayaks, canoes, and stand-up paddleboards for various durations or join guided canoe camping trips and special event floats. The canoe camping trip includes navigating rapids, wildlife viewing, and camping with provided gear and meals. Special event floats include birding, brewery, full moon, fireworks, and fall foliage themed paddles with guides and shuttles.
extraNote: 0-24 hours before trip: no refund · 24-72 hours before trip: 50% refund via gift card · Over 72 hours before trip: full refund via gift card · Refund via gift card for trips cancelled due to dangerous weather or water conditions · Trips cancelled for dangerous weather: high winds above 15mph, thunder/lightning, heavy rain/hail · No cancellation for clouds or rain · Shop in Wormleysburg, Harrisburg, PA
